description: Enforced field set, the assurance_level enum, and the structure vocabulary for a host-neutral, evidence-bound closure-restraint record. Single source read by scripts/validate_closure_restraint.py; the prose closure-restraint-record.schema.md documents intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (conclusion_ref and burden_ref non-empty; imposed_structure drawn from the structure vocabulary; a non-empty imposed_structure requires provenance_refs; no VERIFIED assurance) stay in the validator. Adapts the CSIR/RICC anti-closure and structure-sealing insight to FRR's kernel rule that descent is licensed only by a declared burden.
